question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**united**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage discusses how the programme developed by early nationalists helped bring different sections of the people together.
 
• The appropriate verb should indicate bringing people together, promoting solidarity.
 
• "**United**" fits well as it denotes bringing together and creating unity.
 
• Other options ("**complicated**", "**dissolved**", "**classified**") do not convey the sense of unity and togetherness required in the context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.
